title: Wild West Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Saddle up for an unforgettable Wild West adventure in Golden, CO! Your Wild West Walking Tour brings history to life as you roam the same streets where gunslingers, gold miners, and frontier legends once walked. With charismatic guides decked out in authentic Wild West gear, you’ll dive into thrilling stories of daring outlaws, booming gold rush days, and gritty pioneers. Whether you choose the 60-minute or 2-hour tour, you’re in for a fun-filled journey packed with jaw-dropping tales and historic charm. Plus, every guest gets a free golden bandana to remember the adventure. Don’t just visit Golden—experience its wild history firsthand!

Visit the website for additional details, discounts, and availability!
